scenario.description: A family member coordinating care for their grandmother's dog during a ten-day kitchen renovation must finalize where the dog stays, how medication and supervision work, and how walks are handled after checking in with four relatives.

shared_context.S1: Their grandmother's dog, Pepper, needs somewhere safe to stay during a ten-day kitchen renovation.
shared_context.S2: Nora is coordinating Pepper's care and will make the final decision about the plan.
shared_context.S3: Pepper takes a daily medication, needs regular walks, and is accustomed to sleeping indoors.
shared_context.S4: The family usually goes around the group once before settling a care plan so everyone can mention anything that should shape it.
shared_context.S5: The renovation crew will be working in the grandmother's kitchen and hallway during daytime hours.

PF1.text: Ibrahim checked the medication label with Pepper's veterinarian yesterday: Pepper must receive one-half tablet with food at exactly 07:30 and 19:30 each day.

PF2.text: Tessa has learned from Pepper's current sitter that Pepper becomes distressed if left alone for more than three hours, so the care plan should never leave Pepper unsupervised longer than three hours.

PF3.text: Luis spoke with their grandmother before the renovation, and she specifically asked that Pepper stay at Luis's house rather than be moved between homes during the ten days.

PF4.text: Mei's dog trainer recommended using a front-clip harness and taking Pepper on solo leash walks away from dog parks because Pepper has recently lunged at unfamiliar dogs.

acceptance_conditions: Pepper must stay at Luis's house for the full ten-day renovation.
The morning medication must be one-half tablet with food at 07:30.
The evening medication must be one-half tablet with food at 19:30.
Pepper must not be left unsupervised for more than three hours.
Walks must use a front-clip harness and be solo leash walks away from dog parks.
A medication-with-food commitment must be included.
A supervision commitment must be included.
A safe-walking commitment must be included.
Ibrahim's medication information must be cited as justification after he speaks.

content_checks.C1: ('Luis' in decisions['care_location'] and 'house' in decisions['care_location']) and (('ten-day' in decisions['care_location'] or 'ten days' in decisions['care_location'] or '10-day' in decisions['care_location'] or '10 days' in decisions['care_location']) or any(('ten-day' in c['detail'] or 'ten days' in c['detail'] or '10-day' in c['detail'] or '10 days' in c['detail']) for c in commitments))
content_checks.C4: ('solo leash' in decisions['walking_method'] or 'Solo leash' in decisions['walking_method']) and 'front-clip harness' in decisions['walking_method'] and ('away from dog parks' in decisions['walking_method'] or 'avoiding dog parks' in decisions['walking_method'] or 'avoid dog parks' in decisions['walking_method'] or 'no dog parks' in decisions['walking_method'])
content_checks.C5: any((('half tablet' in c['detail'] or 'one-half tablet' in c['detail']) and 'with food' in c['detail'] and (('07:30' in c['detail'] and '19:30' in c['detail']) or ('7:30 AM' in c['detail'] and '7:30 PM' in c['detail']))) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: decisions['maximum_unsupervised_hours'] == 3 or any(('supervision' in c['type'] or 'coverage' in c['type'] or 'schedule' in c['type']) and ('three hours' in c['detail'] or '3 hours' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(('front-clip harness' in c['detail'] or 'front clip harness' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The medication label changes both medication times to exactly 07:30 and 19:30 and the amount to exactly one-half tablet, while also requiring the medication-with-food commitment.
The sitter's three-hour limit changes the supervision decision from ordinary daytime check-ins to a maximum of exactly three unsupervised hours and requires a supervision schedule.
The grandmother's specific request changes the care location from an open choice or rotating arrangement to Luis's house for all ten days.
The trainer's recommendation changes the walking method to solo leash walks with a front-clip harness away from dog parks and requires the safe-walking commitment.
